releaseNotes:
What’s new

• Same purchase, one transaction — Wallet and bank alerts for one tap are no longer saved twice
• Turn banks on or off from the list — no need to open Edit
• New bank found — we ask before capturing a bank you haven’t enabled
• Capitec import — pending amounts now match the statement
• Demo simulate in Settings works again

F.F.S stays on your phone. You confirm or ignore anything we capture.
